name: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Musu
source: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Musu takes place in the year 1996 during a short period of time on April 14th in Skinner's home within a residential neighborhood. The principal of Springfield Elementary School named Seymour Skinner, who lives on and owns his own home in the aforementioned peaceful neighbourhood, has invited Superintendent Chalmers to his home, to enjoy a home-cooked meal of his making. After Superintendent Chalmers arrives, something goes amiss, and things don't go according to plan. Will Seymour be able to salvage this meal as well as Chalmers's perception of him?
translation: 《海猫之夜》的故事发生在1996年的4月14日，地点是斯金纳位于住宅区的家中。斯普林菲尔德小学的校长西摩·斯金纳（Seymour Skinner）在上述宁静的街区居住并拥有自己的家，他邀请查尔默斯警监到他家，享受他亲手做的家常饭菜。查尔默斯警司到达后，出现了一些问题，事情没有按计划进行。西摩能否挽回这顿饭以及查尔默斯对他的看法？
